purpose: Research log for the local representation classifier. Dataset labels are layout-derived proxies, not task-sufficiency ground truth.

dataset.name: pierreguillou/DocLayNet-small
dataset.license: Upstream CDLA-Permissive-1.0; mirror metadata states other
dataset.split_identifier: source official train/val/test; source document filename groups checked disjoint
dataset.label_limit: Heuristic mappings from layout annotations, not human sufficiency labels

experiments.hypothesis: Verify the transfer-learning and metric pipeline on a single short end-to-end run.
experiments.change_from_baseline: One-epoch pipeline pilot before the selected eight-epoch run
experiments.evaluation_split: historical test, now exposed and diagnostic
experiments.safety_errors: Three of four pixels-required proxy pages predicted as a cheaper class.
experiments.decision: Pipeline smoke run only; not a candidate model. This use is included to disclose historical test exposure.

experiments.hypothesis: Reproduce the existing learned baseline before modifying it.
experiments.architecture: MobileNetV3-Small pretrained on ImageNet, 224x224, AdamW, class-weighted cross-entropy
experiments.change_from_baseline: None; committed checkpoint and script reproduced
experiments.hardware: Windows 11 CPU, 16 logical CPUs, no CUDA, torch 2.14.1+cpu
experiments.evaluation_split: historical source test; previously consulted, diagnostic only

safety_errors.label: pixels_required
safety_errors.inspection: large phone and portrait on magazine page

experiments.decision: Retain as baseline artifact; false pixel-discard 2/4 and tiny critical support do not support safe reduction.

experiments.hypothesis: Independent OCR/layout signals may catch raw model errors.
experiments.architecture: Existing ONNX MobileNet plus Tesseract and existing deterministic heuristic gate
experiments.change_from_baseline: No model changes; evaluate identical samples using raw, heuristic, and composed predictions
experiments.hardware: Windows 11 CPU, 16 logical CPUs, ONNX Runtime CPU and local Tesseract
experiments.safety_errors: Two validation critical pages were high-confidence text_sufficient and visual_required=false; supports are only 7 pixels_required and 2 mixed.
experiments.runtime_measurements: Full pipeline validation median 1506 ms / p95 2437 ms; test median 1496 ms / p95 2376 ms, includes OCR.
experiments.decision: Existing heuristic conflict gate helps but is not a sufficient safety guarantee; model output must not authorize pixel deletion.

experiments.hypothesis: Max-softmax confidence may support conservative abstention.
experiments.change_from_baseline: Validation-only calibration metrics and confidence-threshold sweep; no parameter fitting

metrics.confidence_error_overlap: mean 0.829 correct vs 0.831 incorrect; median 0.858 vs 0.901

experiments.safety_errors: At threshold .99, 0/9 critical errors but 57/63 abstained and 48/54 text/structure cases were unnecessarily preserved; one incorrect case confidence 0.9920.
experiments.runtime_measurements: Threshold computation over stored validation scores; negligible relative to inference, not separately timed.
experiments.decision: Do not adopt threshold .99; small proxy set and extreme preserve rate do not establish useful calibration.

experiments.hypothesis: Class-weighted loss may trade majority-class accuracy for rare proxy-class recall.
experiments.architecture: Same MobileNetV3-Small, ImageNet initialization, 224x224, AdamW; only class weighting disabled
experiments.change_from_baseline: No class weighting; same train/validation, batch 16, 8 epochs; validation checkpoint selection; test evaluation disabled
experiments.hardware: Windows 11 CPU, 16 logical CPUs, no CUDA, torch 2.14.1+cpu
experiments.evaluation_split: validation 63 only; historical test was not run
experiments.safety_errors: Same composed critical count; no improvement in pixel-safety errors. One seed, only 2 mixed validation pages.
experiments.runtime_measurements: Not separately benchmarked; same architecture and preprocessing.
experiments.decision: Reject candidate and retain weighted baseline; raw macro F1 gain is small and did not improve composed safety or macro F1.

experiments.hypothesis: Image degradation may change content-only model predictions.
experiments.architecture: Existing weighted MobileNetV3-Small, ONNX Runtime CPU
experiments.change_from_baseline: Native JPEG quality 40 and quarter-resolution downsample/upscale then JPEG quality 40
experiments.evaluation_split: validation 63; fixed layout proxy labels; model-only perturbation, OCR unchanged/not rerun
experiments.safety_errors: The quarter-resolution perturbation increases pixels-required proxy misses from 1/7 to 2/7.
experiments.runtime_measurements: Included in local evaluator; no separate timing claim.
experiments.decision: Report as deterministic sensitivity only; no training or policy change.

experiments.hypothesis: ONNX Runtime CPU remains a practical compact local inference backend.
experiments.change_from_baseline: 100 warm ONNX selector calls on 20 validation images; fresh process cold start
experiments.decision: Keep ONNX: parity and prior 10.58x isolated inference speedup support it; memory figures include runtime/Python, and wheel portability remains unverified.

unmeasured: A meaningful independent screenshot test set

final_fallback_policy.model_load_failure: pixels_required, heuristic provenance, pixel dependency prior 1.0
final_fallback_policy.successful_but_uncertain_or_visual_confl: existing selector confidence and heuristic-conflict policy applies
final_fallback_policy.query_conditioned_sufficiency: not available in current perception selector; no output class authorizes destructive pixel removal
